mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, it is 52 degrees under overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a waxing gibbous moon visible overhead.

Contractors will begin crack filling on several Verona streets starting September 28, which may cause minor traffic delays. Also, the Plan Commission meets October 5 to review several development proposals, including projects at Country View Court and the Sub-Zero site at Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Hop Haus Trivia today. Tomorrow, you can visit the downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, or catch trivia night at The Bogey Factory.
On September 5, officers investigated a string of incidents where vehicles on Main Street and nearby areas were targeted with a viral cheese-on-the-windshield prank.
Culver's of Verona is currently undergoing a remodel and will open today at 10:00 AM to serve up today's flavor of the day.
